articles.title: Watching Roku’s AI channel is like eating from a trough
articles.description: The appeal of free ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channels has always been the way they make it easier to (re)discover classic films and series. articles.title: OpenAI puts the brakes on a new model because it's supposedly too powerful
articles.description: OpenAI says it is pausing "internal activities" around an in-development AI model, Astra, because it doesn't yet meet new security standards the company is putting in place.
